# Space and Tech Engineering LLP

> Made in India drone components

We are a small team of hardware and firmware engineers making flight controllers, ESCs and GPS modules that Indian builders can actually get support for.

## Aazmuth flight controller
Category: Flight controllers
Status: Available
URL: https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/product.html?p=aazmuth-flight-controller

Separate IMU modules connect over 20-pin Aazmuth Bus connectors, with each sensor on its own isolated bus. Built for defense, industry, agriculture, startups and universities.

Highlights:
- Isolated sensors, triple redundancy
- Modular IMU boards on 20-pin Aazmuth Bus
- For defense, industry, agriculture, startups and universities

Specifications:
- Microcontroller: STM32 H7, Cortex-M7
- Clock speed: Up to 480 MHz
- Memory: 2 MB flash, 1 MB RAM
- Redundancy: 3 IMUs, 2 barometers
- Size: 92 x 54 x 14.6 mm
- Weight: 63 g

Docs:
- Overview: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/overview
- Pinout: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/pinout-diagram
- Calibration: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/basic-configuration-and-calibration
- Sensors: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/sensor-integration-and-peripheral-hardware-connection
- Dimensions: https://spaceandtech-engineerings.gitbook.io/space-and-tech-engineerings-docs/flight-controller/aazmuth/dimensions
